versos.texto_bv: Eles entregaram o dinheiro aos artesãos e aos construtores para comprarem pedras de pedreira, madeiras para as junções e para cobrirem com vigas os edifícios que os reis de Judá haviam destruído.
versos.traducao_literal: E deram aos artesãos e aos construtores, para comprar pedras de pedreira, e madeiras para as junções, e para cobrir com vigas os edifícios que destruíram os reis de Judá.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): 'pedras de pedreira' (BV, foco na origem/local de extração) vs. 'pedras lavradas/trabalhadas' (NTLH/ARA/NVIPT convergem, foco no estado de acabamento da pedra). — evidência: NTLH: 'pedras trabalhadas'; ARA: 'pedras lavradas'; NVIPT: 'pedras lavradas'. As três referências convergem em um termo que descreve a pedra já lavrada/talhada, enquanto a BV (seguindo a traducao_literal, que também usa 'pedreira') descreve a origem da pedra. Trocar mudaria o que é predicado sobre a pedra (origem vs. estado) — juízo de sentido que extrapola revisão de forma.

kjv.texto: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

vizinhos.10: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the Lord, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the Lord, to repair and amend the house:
vizinhos.12: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

web.texto: even to the carpenters and to the builders gave they it, to buy cut stone, and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

vizinhos.10: They delivered it into the hand of the workmen who had the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and the workmen who labored in Yahweh’s house gave it to mend and repair the house;
vizinhos.12: The men did the work faithfully: and their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and others of the Levites, all who were skillful with instruments of music.

versos.texto_bv: Diante dele, derrubaram os altares dos baalins. Josias cortou as colunas solares que estavam acima deles, despedaçou e reduziu a pó as aserás, as imagens esculpidas e as imagens fundidas, e espalhou o pó sobre as sepulturas dos que lhes ofereciam sacrifícios.
versos.traducao_literal: E derrubaram diante dele os altares dos baalins; e as colunas solares que estavam acima deles cortou; e as aserás, e as imagens esculpidas, e as imagens fundidas quebrou e reduziu a pó; e espalhou sobre a face das sepulturas dos que sacrificavam a elas.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): 'colunas solares' (BV) pode não ser o mesmo objeto cultual que 'altares de incenso' (NTLH/ARA/NVIPT convergem nesse termo para o mesmo item). — evidência: NTLH: 'altares de incenso que estavam em cima deles'; ARA: 'os altares de incenso que estavam acima deles'; NVIPT: 'os altares de incenso que ficavam acima deles'. As três referências convergem em 'altares de incenso', divergindo de 'colunas solares' (também em 34.7). Corrigir exigiria decidir qual é o referente correto do termo original — juízo de sentido, fora do escopo de revisão de forma; recomenda-se revisão de fidelidade/terminologia antes de promoção.

kjv.texto: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

vizinhos.3: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
vizinhos.5: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

web.texto: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and the incense altars that were on high above them he cut down; and the Asherah poles, and the engraved images, and the molten images, he broke in pieces, and made dust of them, and strewed it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

vizinhos.3: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the Asherah poles, and the engraved images, and the molten images.
vizinhos.5: He burnt the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.

versos.texto_bv: Ele derrubou os altares, triturou as aserás e as imagens esculpidas até reduzi-las a pó e cortou todas as colunas solares em toda a terra de Israel. Depois voltou para Jerusalém.
versos.traducao_literal: E derrubou os altares; e as aserás e as imagens esculpidas triturou para reduzir a pó; e todas as colunas solares cortou em toda a terra de Israel; e voltou para Jerusalém.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Mesmo ponto de 34.4: 'colunas solares' (BV) vs. 'altares de incenso' (NTLH/ARA/NVIPT convergem). — evidência: NTLH: 'quebrando todos os altares de incenso'; ARA: 'cortou todos os altares de incenso'; NVIPT: 'despedaçou todos os altares de incenso'. As três referências convergem contra a BV. Mesma reserva de 34.4: correção exigiria juízo semântico sobre o referente do termo original, não cabe nesta revisão de forma.

kjv.texto: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

vizinhos.6: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
vizinhos.8: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the Lord his God.

web.texto: He broke down the altars, and beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, and returned to Jerusalem.

vizinhos.6: He did this in the cities of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.
vizinhos.8: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair Yahweh’s house his God.
